title: some key of my keyboard is not working
ai_answer:
Possible cause: Dust, dirt, or debris is blocking the key.  
Solution:  
1. Turn off/unplug the keyboard and gently shake it or use compressed air to clear the blockage.  
2. Restart your computer to reset keyboard settings and drivers.  
3. If the key still doesn’t work, test with an external keyboard or update the keyboard driver from the manufacturer’s website.
